```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

Overlays open and close **entirely client-side**, so every trigger on this page
works — click the buttons and try the menus. Each overlay also has an `inputId`
so you can open it from the server with `shad_dialog_open()` /
`shad_sheet_open()` / etc., and read menu selections with `input$id`. The
[Overlays & the server](overlays-and-server.html) guide covers the reactive
half.

## Dialog

A modal centred over a dimming backdrop. Supply a `trigger` to open it from the
UI; the content portals to `<body>` on open.

```{r}
demo(
  shad_dialog(
    "demo_dialog",
    trigger = shad_button("Edit profile"),
    title = "Edit profile",
    description = "Make changes to your profile here. Click save when done.",
    shad_input("d_name", label = "Name", value = "Ada Lovelace"),
    shad_input("d_user", label = "Username", value = "@ada"),
    footer = shad_dialog_close_button("Save changes")
  )
)
```

## Sheet & drawer

A `shad_sheet()` slides in from an edge (`side`); a `shad_drawer()` rises from
the bottom with a drag handle. Both are ideal for secondary forms and detail
panes.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_sheet(
    "demo_sheet", side = "right",
    trigger = shad_button("Open sheet", variant = "outline"),
    title = "Notifications",
    description = "You have 3 unread messages.",
    shad_p("Sheet body content goes here.")
  )
  shad_drawer(
    "demo_drawer",
    trigger = shad_button("Open drawer", variant = "outline"),
    title = "Move goal",
    description = "Set your daily activity target.",
    shad_p("Drawer body content goes here.")
  )
})
```

## Popover

A small floating panel anchored to its trigger — good for pickers and quick
forms.

```{r}
demo(
  shad_popover(
    "demo_popover",
    trigger = shad_button("Dimensions", variant = "outline"),
    title = "Dimensions",
    shad_input("po_w", label = "Width", value = "100%"),
    shad_input("po_h", label = "Height", value = "25px")
  )
)
```

## Tooltip & hover-card

`shad_tooltip()` shows a terse label on hover/focus; `shad_hover_card()` reveals
a richer panel after a short delay.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_tooltip(
    trigger = shad_button(icon = "info", size = "icon", aria_label = "Info"),
    content = "Add to library"
  )
  shad_hover_card(
    trigger = shad_button("@shadshiny", variant = "link"),
    tags$div(
      style = "max-width:16rem;display:grid;gap:0.35rem",
      tags$strong("shadshiny"),
      shad_muted("A framework-free port of shadcn/ui for Shiny.")
    )
  )
})
```

## Dropdown menu

A menu of actions off a trigger. Items carry icons, shortcuts and a
`destructive` flag; read the chosen item with `input$id`.

```{r}
demo(
  shad_dropdown_menu(
    "demo_menu",
    trigger = shad_button("Open menu", variant = "outline"),
    shad_menu_label("My account"),
    shad_menu_separator(),
    shad_menu_item("profile", "Profile", icon = "circle", shortcut = "⇧⌘P"),
    shad_menu_item("settings", "Settings", icon = "more-horizontal"),
    shad_menu_separator(),
    shad_menu_item("logout", "Log out", destructive = TRUE)
  )
)
```

## Context menu

Right-click the target zone to open a menu at the cursor.

```{r}
demo(
  shad_context_menu(
    "demo_ctx",
    target = tags$div(
      style = paste("display:grid;place-items:center;height:8rem;width:100%;",
        "border:1px dashed var(--shad-border);border-radius:var(--shad-radius-lg);",
        "color:var(--shad-muted-foreground)"),
      "Right-click here"
    ),
    shad_menu_item("back", "Back", shortcut = "⌘["),
    shad_menu_item("forward", "Forward", shortcut = "⌘]"),
    shad_menu_separator(),
    shad_menu_item("reload", "Reload", shortcut = "⌘R")
  )
)
```

## Menubar

An application menu bar — each `shad_menubar_menu()` opens a dropdown; hovering
across the bar moves between them.

```{r}
demo(
  shad_menubar(
    "demo_menubar",
    shad_menubar_menu("File",
      shad_menu_item("new", "New tab", shortcut = "⌘T"),
      shad_menu_item("open", "Open…", shortcut = "⌘O"),
      shad_menu_separator(),
      shad_menu_item("print", "Print", shortcut = "⌘P")),
    shad_menubar_menu("Edit",
      shad_menu_item("undo", "Undo", shortcut = "⌘Z"),
      shad_menu_item("redo", "Redo", shortcut = "⇧⌘Z")),
    shad_menubar_menu("View",
      shad_menu_item("zoom_in", "Zoom in"),
      shad_menu_item("zoom_out", "Zoom out"))
  )
)
```

## Command palette

`shad_command()` is a searchable action list. Inline it (below) or set
`dialog = TRUE` for a ⌘K spotlight overlay you open from the server with the
`shadshiny:invoke` message. Type to filter.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(
    style = "max-width:26rem;width:100%",
    shad_command(
      "demo_cmd", placeholder = "Type a command or search…",
      shad_command_group("Suggestions",
        shad_command_item("cal", "Calendar", icon = "calendar"),
        shad_command_item("search", "Search", icon = "search"),
        shad_command_item("mail", "Send mail", icon = "mail")),
      shad_command_group("Settings",
        shad_command_item("profile", "Profile", shortcut = "⌘P"),
        shad_command_item("billing", "Billing", shortcut = "⌘B"))
    )
  )
)
```
